basic_profile.bio: I'm a 19-year-old college student from Seattle, majoring in Computer Science. I have a passion for coding, particularly in Python, and love creating visualizations with Manim. When I'm not buried in code, I enjoy arranging floral designs as a relaxing hobby. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after classes and during weekends. Currently single, I enjoy hanging out with friends and exploring new cafes around town.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I gained my programming knowledge through a combination of formal education and online courses. I've been coding since high school and have a particular interest in Python for data science and visualization. My floral design skills are self-taught, developed through online tutorials and hands-on practice.
